title: Chapter 452: Sword God Returns
content:
Chapter 452: Sword God Returns

After being seriously injured last time, the Sword God held a grudge against the Great Locust Domain.

After recovering from his injury, the Sword God found a few of his old friends and planned to massacre the Great Locust Domain.

But at this time, someone learned that the Sword God had found the trace of the second prince in the Great Locust Domain.

They were unwilling to take action.

Because most of them had already joined other forces, if they helped the Sword God at this time, it would easily be misunderstood.

The Sword God tried his best to persuade them, and in the end only the two strongest kings who had supported the second prince before were willing to go to the Great Locust Domain with the Sword God.

The Sword God also learned that the Great Locust Domain had defeated the Demon King and its sphere of influence had exceeded that of an ordinary fourth-level empire. He became even more excited and wanted to take over this territory.

…

On this day, the weather was fine and Wang Shuo was discussing the details of the enthronement with Zhu Dongheng in the Lord's Mansion.

Suddenly, he received news from his men.

In the north of Tiexue City, there were three extremely powerful auras that were rapidly approaching Tiexue City.

Wang Shuo was alert.

During this period, Wang Shuo had established an early warning mechanism within the territory.

Wang Shuo immediately summoned all the senior warriors and prepared for battle.

Not long after, the three strongest kings flew over the Iron Blood City.

"Wang Shuo, your Sword God grandfather is here again, come out and surrender quickly."

The Sword God was full of confidence this time.

Wang Shuo walked out of the crowd, looked at the Sword God from a distance, and said contemptuously: "Old thief, I couldn't kill you last time, and you dare to die this time?"

"You don't know how high the sky is, then let you see the gap between the senior warrior and the strongest king."

After that, the Sword God swung the long sword in his hand and rushed straight towards Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo was not afraid at all. He had a passive skill to resist a fatal blow, and he also had a resurrection coin.

The Shura Demon-Breaking Spear in his hand dragged a long trace on the ground.

Then the spear head swung and stabbed the Sword God suddenly. At the same time, a dragon-shaped phantom, with a ferocious mouth, bit the Sword God.

The Sword God didn't even blink, and with two swipes of his sword, the dragon-shaped phantom was chopped into pieces and disappeared.

Wang Shuo kept responding to the danger, but the Sword God in his prime also learned the lesson of underestimating the enemy last time.

Wang Shuo was beaten back step by step, and Zhao Bangde and others who were watching the battle were terrified.

Gong Zheng even wanted to rush up immediately.

Wang Shuo wiped a trace of blood from the corner of his mouth and stopped others from wanting to help.

Because as soon as they moved, the two strongest kings brought by the Sword God would obviously join the battle immediately.

Another reason was that Wang Shuo wanted to seriously experience how strong the strongest king was.

Since the Demon King came over, Wang Shuo would find the Demon King to learn from him whenever he had time, and now he has some experience.

Wang Shuo wanted to feel more pressure from the Sword God, and see if there was a chance to break through to the strongest king.

Although, this might not be easy.

"Come again."

Wang Shuo directly used the Sword God as a sparring partner.

From the beginning, he was surrounded by dangers, but he could barely resist. Wang Shuo's desire for a protracted war made him react faster and faster.

Gradually, he was barely qualified to fight the Sword God.

But this made the Sword God a little unhappy.

This situation would obviously make him lose face in front of his two companions.

Then the Sword God snorted coldly, suddenly increased the strength in his hand, and a light blue sword energy slashed out.

Wang Shuo did not expect that the Sword God would suddenly make such a move.

As expected, Wang Shuo was hit and flew backwards, but he was not seriously injured. After all, the defense of the Shura Armor was quite strong.
